purpose.en: Build the glutes and strengthen hip extension.

text.zh: 用臀部把腿向后推，骨盆和躯干保持不动
text.en: Drive the leg back with your glutes while your pelvis and trunk stay still

text.zh: 弹力带固定在前方低处，椅子只用来扶稳
text.en: Anchor the band low in front; use the chair only for balance.

text.zh: 不要腰往后仰，慢慢放回
text.en: Do not arch your lower back, and return slowly.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of extending the hip.

cautions.zh: 先做 1 组轻松的 6 次；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 6 reps, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 不要把弹力带固定在椅子上
cautions.en: Never anchor the band to the chair.
